note: The one definition of what the page and the bubble say to each other. Edit here, then run node tools/gen-protocol.mjs. Generated files say so at the top and are checked by gates/protocol.mjs.

queued.why: a sentence said while ליבה is speaking waits; the bubble shows it waits

outbox.why: no network: the sentence is kept and will be sent; the bubble shows how many wait

cmd.why: a command for the phone; from the channel it is signed (tools/cmd.mjs) and the phone verifies it again (Signed.kt)

state.why: the page tells the bubble what it is doing, so the two never disagree about who is speaking

memSync.why: device-mem: the page sends the phone its memory - the 500 facts used most, the person cards, the rules - so the bubble can answer when the page is down

memAck.why: device-mem: the page stored what the phone kept offline; the phone lets those go

remind.why: proactive: the date reminders, so the phone's alarm says them even when the page is dead or the phone just restarted

senseAck.why: sense-bus-ears: the page stored them; the phone lets them go

senseCfg.why: sense-bus-ears: which apps Meir said to listen to (memory/settings.senses.apps); empty means none

place.why: shabbat-engine: the place the Shabbat times are computed for (lat, lon, minutes before sunset) - the phone computes the windows itself, offline

mirror.why: local-brain: the page's picture of the state (tasks that matter, the brief, who is awake), every 15 s when it changed - the bubble answers "איפה עצרנו", "מה פתוח", "מה תקוע", "מי המוח" from it when the page is dead

powerCfg.why: duty-governor: Meir's daily battery budget (memory/settings.power.dailyPct) - the phone chooses its gear against it

pulse.why: one sign of life per device, edge-triggered (a change, or every five minutes); the page keeps it in one fixed document pulse/<dev>

memAsk.why: device-mem: what Meir asked the phone to remember while the page was down, sent when it is back

sense.why: sense-bus-ears: what the phone heard (notifications from the apps Meir named), kept on the phone until the page acks

calSync.why: calendar-sense: the calendar window (yesterday to a week ahead) as one snapshot, read only, only after Meir allowed it

ctx.why: context-fusion: what the phone knows now - screen, lock, headset, call, when Meir woke - sent when it changes

power.why: power-ledger: the day's energy - mAh and percent by subsystem, the projection for a whole day, the phone's own drain beside it - every five minutes

compat: Adding an optional field is compatible and keeps the version; removing or renaming a message or a field bumps it.

states.note: One state table for the page and the bubble. A move not listed here is recorded as a fault (P_STATE_ILLEGAL / E_STATE_ILLEGAL) and still applied - the table is tightened from what the field reports, never by breaking the phone.
